event: Patch: skill amp now scales Milk's ATK buff, which later makes Milk the raid leader.
Guild Conquest launches with Brightseeker and Pinot Noir. The skill-amp nerf lands the same day. Scores are in the hundreds of millions.
Tea Knight (raid-only buff) becomes the centrepiece; the 7G 'just copy it' deck sets the template of Milk as leader.
Tiger Lily + Pomegranate beam synergy documented (+69% skill amp, beam count scales with multi-hit).
Cheesecake-overrides-Milk measured; retrying for the 'world line' where buffs land right becomes the ceiling method.
First move-speed alignment deck (157G at 628M).
Cheesecake lottery deck: 4,230 runs in one season for about 87×.
Patch: manual control in Guild Conquest removed (placement now from composition); Cherry Cola added; same-type buffs compared on final value.
The #1 guild posts an 827.6G run; it still dies at the 17 s wipe.
The '470× club' post: level-down fillers to Lv.1 and the ATK order Milk › Brightseeker › Skating Queen › Macaron. The Melon Soda deck hits 562G.
670M-power guide: six Lv.1 non-carries, Cherry enters the deck, 216–244×.
The Cherry deck guides are posted on Naver and DC; 866G at 1.2–1.38G. The standard rune and gear table forms.
Brightseeker skill-haste study: breakpoint about 40 total haste.
Patch: gear presets, Candy Shade Pouch pet (replaces Panda Dumpling), Princess Bari and Moon Rabbit.
Cherry deck passes 1T (1T 116G at 1.74G). A Pomegranate is seen alive past the 17 s wipe.
Season 5 opens (to 09-28 12:00 KST). The first reports of cookies surviving the 17 s wipe appear the same day.
1.62T at about 600× with a 10★ Brightseeker on only four haste lines.
1T 312G at 1.8G with Pomegranate at Lv.1.
The '2T club' post: 1T 999G with the plain Cherry deck at about 3.07G (650×).
crumb.gg Season 5 board: #1 at 3T 226G, many players above 2T.
The Season 5 #1 player across Seasons 1–5: 208G → 477G → 1.1T → 1.8T → 3.2T.
Season #1 scores: 248G, 882G, 1T 111G, 1T 786G, 3T 226G. #50 rose from 1T 031G (Season 4) to 1T 916G (Season 5).
Season 5 closes: #1 날씨의아이 3T 305G, #50 2T 025G. The #2 posts his lobby: Melon Soda deck, no move speed, 4.23G.
Season 6 opens on the same boss; 2.92T lands within the first hour.
Arsen reaches 5T 115G, far ahead of #2 at 3T 740G; the gallery hunts his 'secret sauce'.
2T 204G with a Cherry deck whose fillers are levelled to outlive the 17 s wipe.
A 100-run log of one Cherry deck at 2.93G: 208–783×, mean 477×.
Season 6 closes: #1 Arsen 6T 276G, #2 4T 910G, #50 3T 341G.
Boss datamine: damage reduction ramps 10% to 90% every 12 s from 10 s elapsed.
Arsen, crumb.gg's developer, credits stacked small optimizations and money, and opens a rune optimizer for 48 h.
10-08 patch notes: Chardonnay (다발 1–2), cookie level cap 120, Milk on a check-in. Season 7 opens after it.
Update 1.5.002: Chardonnay (CRIT% +60–120%, 다발 1–2) and level cap 120. Season 7 opens on the same Piñata.
Posters swap Macaron for Chardonnay and Cherry for Melon Soda: 4T 227G at 4.55G on day one.
서신우's 2.5T Chardonnay guide: all twelve cookies alive past the 17 s wipe.
Chardonnay deck at about 1000×: 4T 300G at 4.29G. Season 7's live #1 is at 10T 266G.
